show.name: Избранный
show.summary: A modest employee of the research institute, Oleg Tyapin, is unexpectedly elected to the Duma of the new convocation. He doesn't want to be a deputy at all, but duty is duty - Tyapin leaves provincial Glebov for Moscow to take on new responsibilities. The hero will go through all the stages of development and formation of himself as a new person, fall in love, and most importantly, experience a lot of comical situations.

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

show.name: Summer Vacation
show.summary: Kim Ha Yeon is an ordinary 18-year-old girl who dreams of a life as dramatic as the ones she sees on screen. Her life takes an unexpected, mystical turn when she heads to the unfamiliar countryside village of Upo-ri for her summer break. There, she crosses paths with Jo Yu Gyeom, the heir to a traditional noble family, and his girlfriend, Sae Ryeong. While he possesses stunning looks and a genius talent for swimming, he lives a colorless existence constrained by old-fashioned rules and repetitive routines. As these two opposites meet in the quiet beauty of Upo-ri, their worlds collide, sparking a transformation in their daily lives and the beginning of a once-in-a-lifetime summer.

show.name: One of a Kind Romance
show.summary: One of a Kind Romance follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.

show.name: The Substitute
show.summary: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas. Kang Geon Tae, the miracle of a "special low-income scholarship student" who does not lose the top rank at Jeonggyeong High, where wealthy people abound. He drew a perfect blueprint toward the first cornerstone of life, the "prestigious university," but the choices he made to survive return as the only stain. He is a figure who falls into a whirlpool by Nam Jae Yeop's irresistible proposal amid the greatest crisis of his life. Nam Jae Yeop, a hexagon full of a gold spoon background, warm visuals and excellent grades, but everything is a mask. As he begins to deviate from the life plan his father wants, his inferiority toward Kang Geon Tae also intensifies. As cracks start to form in his perfect daily life, he begins to run amok like a grenade with the pin pulled.

show.name: Silent Echoes
show.summary: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.name: The Glory Fades
show.summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
show.summary: Feng Weiyue, a modern-day dimensional research team leader, has an accidents during a space experiment and transmigrates to the Yinbei Dynasty together with her colleague Ye Changjiu and her boss Jun Qingye. Feng Weiyue wakes up in the body of the Grand Tutor's legitimate daughter, only to find herself in the bedchamber of the Prince of Rong, Mo Yuya, stuck with the dreadful reputation of a "boy-crazy princess consort". Meanwhile, Mo Yuya is being constantly targeted for assassination by Gu Nanke, the master of the Xingzhao Pavilion. Feng Weiyue unexpectedly discovers that she shares a tangled connection with Gu Nanke, and the dimensional bracelet she brought through time becomes her ultimate cheat code.

show.summary: Lomnuea used to believe in love. Then his cousin Pong's marriage proposal is rejected by his long-time girlfriend Green, who leaves him for a wealthier man, and ultimately takes his own life, leaving Lomnuea with a deep resentment. When Lomnuea later comes to the rescue of Daenchol, a politician's son who had hired Green to pose as his girlfriend to spite his father, it leads to a misunderstanding that sparks immediate hatred. As they're drawn closer, certain feelings emerge, transforming a game once fueled only by vengeance into a game of the heart. As love becomes a weapon of revenge, will the two be able to distinguish what's sincere from what's a strategy being used to win?

body.name: Doge's Palace
body.summary: Lucy Worsley travels to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages.

show.name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
show.summary:
Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle opens up the hidden rooms, sealed archives and private spaces, to uncover the untold stories behind the buildings and the people who lived in them.

Across four episodes, Lucy unlocks the secrets of Britain's majestic Blenheim Palace (birthplace of Winston Churchill); the glittering Versailles Palace in France - and one of its most infamous residents, Queen Marie Antoinette; the fairytale castle Neuschwanstein in Germany; and Venice's intriguing Doge's Palace.

While these spectacular palaces host millions of visitors every year, Lucy Worsley's Keys To The Castle will be no ordinary tour. Instead, she will guide viewers through the architecture, design, art, personal treasures and artefacts found in the spaces the public rarely get to see, to reveal a fascinating and surprising take on some of history's most important events, and the people who lived through them.

body.name: Versailles
body.summary:
Lucy Worsley has been given the keys to the spectacular palace of Versailles in France. The palace is huge – there are 2,000 rooms to explore, and everywhere Lucy discovers gold and more gold. This is one of the biggest and most ostentatious palaces she has ever seen.

Lucy is here to find out more about France's most notorious queen, Marie Antoinette, who arrived at Versailles from Austria aged just 14 to marry the heir to the French throne. Her story is one of money, sex, power and snowy white goats.

body.name: Neuschwanstein
body.summary: Lucy Worsley has the keys to the ultimate fairytale castle: Neuschwanstein. What appears to be a a classic fairytale castle in a medieval Gothic style, built on a remote rocky outcrop in southern Germany, is actually a 19th-century creation of Bavarian king Ludwig II. A tragic figure obsessed with fairytales, Ludwig's creation later became, in a dark twist, a hiding place for millions of artefacts stolen by the Nazis from Jewish families.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: WWE Monday Night RAW
show.summary: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.

show.name: Still a Family
show.summary: In 2008, with China's economy booming, the Sai Duoxi family living on the Jiaodong Peninsula undergoes a dramatic change. A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.summary: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

show.name: King of Bar Host
show.summary: The Legacy is a paradise promised only to the one who becomes the King of Bar Host at the mysterious Remember Club. But the road to that glory is a deadly game, where every step demands a trade of dignity… and life. Than, a struggling musician drowning in debt, is forced into the seductive yet cruel world of bar hosts, where beauty and desire are weapons. There, he clashes with Ray, the club's reigning star: a man obsessed with uncovering the dark secret behind The Legacy and the lover he lost to it. When the truth behind the Masked Deer is finally revealed, Than and Ray realize that The Legacy isn't a reward… it's a trap, a deadly paradise that never ends.

show.name: Amici
show.summary:
Everyone has grieved the loss of someone who is still alive. AMICI is about that first time.

Miguel lost his father and locked himself in his room. His mother and sister don't know what to do with him anymore. Until, one summer in Cascais filled with beaches, parties, and sleepless nights, Felipe appears. Miguel laughs again, goes out again, and falls in love without realizing it.

When Felipe disappears, Miguel discovers that the first heartbreak hurts like a funeral. And it's with his mother and sister, the two who remain, that he learns what he couldn't learn from his father: how to say goodbye.

AMICI is a story about growing up, loving, and letting go. And sometimes about learning to dance in the dark.

body.name: Brooklyn Nets at Minnesota Timberwolves
body.summary:
LaMelo Ball and the Minnesota Timberwolves (11-4) host three-time NBA All-Star Julius Randle and the Brooklyn Nets (3-11) from Target Center in Minneapolis, Minn.

Ball has been transcendent in his first season in Minnesota, leading the Timberwolves to wins in seven of their last eight games, including a season-high 34 points in a victory over Milwaukee earlier this month. Minnesota also features four-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year Rudy Gobert, who ranks fifth in the NBA in rebounds (11.1 RPG). The Nets are led by Randle, in his first season in Brooklyn, and 2023 NBA champion Michael Porter Jr.

Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.
